frames.name: AI concept
frames.meaning: Predicts. What it produces is a likely guess, never a checked fact.

frames.name: Agent harness
frames.meaning: Acts. Runs the loop and the tools the model asks for.

frames.name: Guard
frames.meaning: Blocks. A plain program that allows or refuses, the same way every time.

frames.name: Skill or agent
frames.meaning: A specialist routine or helper that a lane calls in.

frames.name: Lane
frames.meaning: A route that one kind of work travels, with its own stops.

frames.name: Record
frames.meaning: Remembers. Files in your repository that outlive any session.

frames.name: Your systems
frames.meaning: What all of this protects: your code and its history.

frames.name: You
frames.meaning: Decides. The choices only a person makes.

frames.name: Outside
frames.meaning: Beyond the machine. Optional, and off unless you turn it on.

motions.name: Token tiles
motions.meaning: Pieces of text the model reads or writes. A dot (·) marks a space.

motions.name: Spinning wheel
motions.meaning: The sampler choosing the next token by weighted chance.

motions.name: Glowing pod with a tag
motions.meaning: A tool call travelling out to do something. The tag says what.

motions.name: Floating verdict
motions.meaning: What a gate decided, and the rule that decided it.

motions.name: Red flash and shockwave
motions.meaning: A guard refused an action. It never ran.

motions.name: Ring ripple
motions.meaning: Green: allowed or passed. Gold: waiting at a gate or on you.

motions.name: Ledger line
motions.meaning: A block written to the append-only audit log, which never rewinds.

motions.name: Tank bands
motions.meaning: What fills the context window, layer by layer, and what compaction squeezes.
